name: Context7
summary: MCP server and CLI that pull up-to-date, version-specific library docs into an AI coding agent's context.
description: Context7 fetches current documentation and code examples for the libraries in your prompt so coding agents stop inventing old APIs. Install with npx ctx7 setup as CLI + Skills or as an MCP server (https://mcp.context7.com/mcp), with tools resolve-library-id and query-docs, manual setup for 30+ MCP clients, and packages for the MCP server, CLI, TypeScript SDK and Vercel AI SDK.
contains: two install modes: CLI + Skills, or MCP server registration
CLI commands: ctx7 library, ctx7 docs; MCP tools: resolve-library-id, query-docs
packages: @upstash/context7-mcp, ctx7, @upstash/context7-sdk, Vercel AI SDK tools
documented manual MCP setup for 30+ clients
pricing: Free $0, Pro $10 per seat/month, Enterprise custom
MIT-licensed MCP server source; the API backend and crawler are private
